Project Name: Evil Eye on Mars

Tagline: Earth’s evil-eye bead, Lake Meke, watching over Martian life

Evil Eye on Mars is an interactive 3D map that helps astronauts choose where to land and explore on Mars. It layers NASA data (MOLA, CRISM, HiRISE) and scores each site on Terra (landing and navigation safety) and Vita (astrobiological potential). Vita is anchored to Lake Meke, Türkiye’s salty crater lake known as “Earth’s evil-eye bead”, our Earth reference for Martian biosignatures.
